product.ta-walkstation-286v.summary: The 286V brought VGA and docking options to the mid-range 286 notebook.
product.ta-walkstation-286v.history: Triumph-Adler presented it in 1991. The German report calls the Olivetti counterpart Notebook A16 in one passage and uses V16 when describing storage.
product.ta-walkstation-286v.technical.co: Docking supported peripheral expansion. The announcement lists 2 MiB of RAM expandable to 6 MiB and a modem or fax-modem card slot.
product.ta-walkstation-286v.technical.ve: BluMach has no runnable profile for this model.
product.ta-walkstation-286v.technical.li: The model-specific firmware and a boot disk remain to be preserved for verification.
product.ta-walkstation-286v.technical.so: Computerwoche · Neue Portables werden in Nürnberg hergestellt · 15 March 1991
